description: Google Locations. Find supported Google locations and retrieve location IDs and country codes (free endpoint).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Search locations supported by Piloterr (cities, countries, etc.) by providing a query string. Returns matching locations ordered by reach.
